## Description

Provide a summary of the changes proposed in this pull request and the motivation behind them.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactoring (code improvement with no change in functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Security fix / dependency update

## How Has This Been Tested?

Describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes.

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with zero errors
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` unit and integration tests pass (55+ tests)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds locally
- [ ] Tested manually in browser

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or real `.env` variables are committed
